messages.content: What is the freezing point point of water at a pressure of 10 kPa?

function.name: thermodynamics_calculate_boiling_point

message.content:
At a pressure of **10 kPa** (≈ 0.1 atm) the freezing point of pure water drops to roughly **–2 °C**.  

Water expands when it freezes, so lowering the pressure slightly depresses the melting temperature. At 10 kPa the depression is about 2 °C below the standard 0 °C freezing point at 1 atm.
